nativeZh: [医] 碲(52号元素); 破伤风

senses.en: a brittle silver-white metalloid element that is related to selenium and sulfur; it is used in alloys and as a semiconductor; occurs mainly as tellurides in ores of copper and nickel and silver and gold
senses.zh: 一种脆的银白色类金属元素，与硒和硫同族，用于合金和半导体，主要以碲化物形式存在于铜、镍、银和金的矿石中。

senses.en: the syllable naming the seventh (subtonic) note of any musical scale in solmization
senses.zh: 单曲化中任何音乐音标的第七音节( 亚音节) 命名
